entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, um, I need to return something. I have my order number if you need it.
I can certainly look into that for you. What is the order number?
It's VF-881-2099. I just... I'm so disappointed.
Okay, I see the order here for the VeloFit Pro-Lite cycling shoes. I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them?

They just don't work for me. I've tried everything... I've adjusted the cleats multiple times, I've tried different socks... but I keep getting terrible blisters on every ride. I can't even ride for more than an hour.
I understand, getting blisters can certainly ruin a ride. Just to confirm, is it a technical fault with the shoe itself, or more of a preference and fit issue?

I guess it's a fit issue. But I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I've never had this problem. I saved up for these, and I just feel awful that they're just sitting here. I really needed this money for other things, you know?
I completely understand your frustration, and I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. Let me just check the purchase date for you. One moment.
Okay... I was just so worried I'd be stuck with them.

Alright, I've pulled up your order details. I see the cycling shoes were delivered 81 days ago. According to our policy, you're still well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? Are you sure? That... that is such a huge relief. Thank you so, so much, David.

You're very welcome. It's no problem at all. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file right now. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the shoes, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Wow. That's perfect. You've really turned my day around. Thank you again.
I'm happy I could help with that. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks, David!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
